module: R4: J and R lenses for Qwen3-14B, and readouts on the reproduced S2 ladder (Gate 2a extension)
model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B at revision 40c069824f4251a91eefaf281ebe4c544efd3e18 (Gate 2a's), verified file by file

fits.recipe: published 4B recipe: first 25 NeelNanda/pile-10k documents (first-25 hash 4111a9cf...), max_seq_len 128, skip_first 4, target layer n - 2 = 38, force_bos False, jacobian-lens 581d3986
fits.R: jlens.fit through the Gate L RelP rules, verbatim: LN rule on block input/post-attention RMSNorms, identity rule on MLP SiLU, half rule (beta 0.5) on the SwiGLU product; QK norms excluded; Qwen3 has no gated norms. Self-tests and a bit-identical forward check before fitting.
fits.stability: a second R fit on documents 25-49
fits.dim_batch: largest of 16/8/4 that fits one document (changes speed, not the result)
fits.environment: the main fast environment (torch 2.11.0+cu128, transformers 5.19.0); A100

validation: no published 14B lens exists. Reported: 1 - cos(J, R) per layer (4B: 0.307 / 0.112 / 0.004 at layers 0 / 16 / 29) and 1 - cos(R, R on documents 25-49) per layer (4B: 0.117 / 0.013 / 0.0003).

readout.prompts: the paper's NEUTRAL_50 (identical to the 4B ladder's prompts)
readout.steering: as M7: the published S2 vector (layer 31) at layer 20, scaled to ratio 0.5908 at coefficient 1; random directions norm-matched
readout.probes: psych_vocab_v1 unchanged; terms whose ' term' form is one token under the Qwen3-14B tokenizer (rebuilt; count reported)
readout.functions: capture_all_layers, lens_readout, ranks_for_tokens from notebooks/03-decursed.ipynb cell 10, verbatim
readout.read_layer: 37 (target - 1), as layer 29 at 4B; all layers stored
readout.gain: per probe, mean over prompts of log(rank_baseline / rank_condition); family = mean over its probes

prediction.R4-P1: specificity (the 4B D4 analogue): at the read layer through R, mean |family gain| over the six focus families (generic_positive, activated_vitality, relief_release, agency_assurance, approach_drive, distress_self_devaluation) for each random direction is < 0.5 x that of S2 -0.5, for at least 2 of the 3 random directions

reported: family gains at every layer for every condition, J and R
the raw vector's ratio at layer 20
